order: fit first, then holdout; each increasing iz then ix, X fastest
streamEncoding: headerless Float64 little-endian signed error metres = 1000 * (spherical DEM reference Y - actual Float32 mesh lookup Y)
reference: same canonical CDM1 GLO90 bilinear sampler and terrainMeshSurfaceY for A and B; no GLO30
maskForIndependentAnalysis: same canonical bilinear coastKm >= 0 for land, <0 for sea; never select points from B

fixedPhysicalBandsForIndependentAnalysis.membership: first boundary >= radius; identical A-based physical bands for both streams, not B's shifted ring IDs
